newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates firmer, uptrend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates firmer, uptrend seen.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates were slightly firmer at midday on Friday and dealers said they expected rates to continue moving higher in coming sessions.
The overnight interbank rate was at 4.987 percent against Thursday's 4.838 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.00-5.05 percent against 4.95-5.00.

The Finance Ministry was scheduled to auction off T$35 billion in seven-year government bonds later on Friday and dealers said the payments, due on Tuesday, were likely to push money rates higher next week.
Government bond market investors were focussing their expectations on the ministry's big afternoon auction, dealers said.
The seven-year 85/3 bond yield ended morning trading at 5.6600 percent and the 10-year 84/1 was at 5.7550.
